تلتهمن (form VIII)
# تَلْتَهِمْنَ (taltahimna) /tal.ta.him.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
# تُلْتَهَمْنَ (tultahamna) /tul.ta.ham.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
